name: Mock Draft Deck
summary:
Mock Draft Deck is a single-player American football management simulator based on the 2027 NFL Draft. Choose one of the 32 teams and a draft length of one to seven rounds, then build a rookie class from a searchable board of 300 prospects.

In single-team mode, the simulator makes the other teams' picks and the player can trade draft picks. Commissioner mode lets the player make every selection. The results include grades for the picks and a shareable draft class, with text and CSV export.
